The programme runs over ten weeks. Each module is offered at four different sessions. You'll be assigned one of the listed sessions for each module. All four sessions cover identical content.

| Module | Tutor | Session 1 | Session 2 | Session 3 | Session 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ✨ [Map](../learning_materials/1_map/index.qmd) | Lucy | Tue 12 Jan, 2:00pm | Wed 13 Jan, 2:00pm | Mon 18 Jan, 2:00pm | Thu 21 Jan, 2:00pm |
| ❔ [Model](../learning_materials/2_model/index.qmd) | Lucy | Tue 26 Jan, 2:00pm | Wed 27 Jan, 2:00pm | Mon 1 Feb, 2:00pm | Thu 4 Feb, 2:00pm |
| 🎰 [Random](../learning_materials/3_random/index.qmd) | Lucy | Tue 9 Feb, 2:00pm | Wed 10 Feb, 2:00pm | Mon 15 Feb, 2:00pm | Thu 18 Feb, 2:00pm |
| 👥 [Valid](../learning_materials/4_valid/index.qmd) | Lucy | Tue 23 Feb, 2:00pm | Wed 24 Feb, 2:00pm | Mon 1 Mar, 2:00pm | Thu 4 Mar, 2:00pm |
| 🏆 [Capstone](../learning_materials/5_capstone/index.qmd) | Lucy | Tue 9 Mar, 2:00pm | Wed 10 Mar, 2:00pm | Mon 15 Mar, 2:00pm | Thu 18 Mar, 2:00pm |
